study type: Observational descriptive study (methodological development and application)
exposure: Piritramide administered by patient-controlled intravenous analgesia (PCIA)
outcome: Quantification of piritramide in colostrum samples
cohort: Colostrum samples were collected from ten nursing mothers who had received piritramide via PCIA during the first 48 hours post-partum.
finding: Low concentrations of piritramide can be found in the first milk (colostrum) after administration via PCIA to nursing mothers, but these concentrations are mostly below the limit of quantification of 30 ng/mL.
